newsitem.title: USA: Death of child born to U.S. musician investigated.
newsitem.headline: Death of child born to U.S. musician investigated.

text.p: Officials said on Wednesday they were reviewing files relating to the death of a boy born last year and apparently fathered by the artist formerly known as Prince.

The office of the Hennepin County Medical Examiner said files in the case were being examined and it may be several weeks before any information is released. Police said they had been asked for assistance but the request was not unusual.
Published reports said twin sisters Erlene and Arlene Mojica, both former employees of Paisley Park, the musician's company, have talked to Minneapolis police regarding the death of the child.

The reports said the child was born to the musician's wife Mayte Garcia-Nelson on Oct. 16, 1996, and was listed on a birth certificate as "Boy Gregory." The child died on Oct. 23, 1996, and the body was cremated the same day.
Erlene Mojica was said to be the child's nanny while Arlene Mojica worked as Mayte's assistant. The death certificate listed the cause of death as a genetic skull deformity.

The musician's publicist had no comment on the reports Wednesday. When asked about the child during an appearance on the "Oprah Winfrey Show" last November, the recording star said only, "Our family exists, it's just beginning" and "it's all good."
